sentenceSets.sentence: His willful misreading of the agreement was either an error that suited him or a decision that was easier to perform as one.

answerChoices.reasoning: Deliberate means intentional and planned, but willful adds the element of obstinate self-will and perverse persistence, not just intentionality.
Intentional means done on purpose, but willful emphasizes the stubborn, self-willed persistence in the misreading, not just purpose.
Obstinate means stubbornly adhering to a position, but willful adds the perverse self-will element—a more active defiance than mere stubbornness.
Calculated means planned with forethought, but willful emphasizes the perverse self-will more than rational calculation.
Purposeful means having clear intention, but willful emphasizes the stubborn, self-willed persistence, not just clear purpose.
Stubborn means refusing to change position, but willful adds the perverse, self-willed quality—more about defiance than mere stubbornness.
Defiant means boldly resistant, but willful emphasizes the perverse self-will rather than opposition to authority.
Knowing means done with full awareness, but willful emphasizes the perverse, self-willed quality, not just awareness.
Accidental means happening by chance, opposite to willful which emphasizes obstinate, perverse self-will in misreading.
Honest means sincere and truthful, opposite to willful misreading which shows perverse self-will in distorting meaning.
Careless means inattentive, opposite to willful which shows active, perverse self-will in the misreading.
